description: This Java source file defines an exception class SubscriptionNotFoundException used in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for handling cases where a subscription ID is not found during operation. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and maintains metadata such as error codes and HTTP status.

classes.name: SubscriptionNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a subscription was not found. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingSearchException. Contains static methods for creation from JSON and parameters, and a nested Builder class.

classes.name: SubscriptionNotFoundException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of SubscriptionNotFoundException with a fluent API, not thread-safe.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionNotFoundException with a message including the subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionNotFoundException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the exception with updated Ditto headers.
